command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /work /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages
cp -a /source/. /work/
cp -a /pytest-deps/. /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/
cp -a /yaml /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/yaml
export PATH=/opt/codex/packages/standalone/releases/0.153.4-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/codex-path:$PATH
cd /work
test ! -e .git
test ! -e benchmarks/local-runs
python3 -I -c "import sys, pytest, yaml; print(sys.version); print(pytest.__version__, yaml.__version__)"
node --version
rg --version
python3 -B scripts/validate.py
python3 -B scripts/sync_featured_benchmark.py --check
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v
limitation: Offline author compatibility validation, not hosted CI or model performance. stdout then stderr; cross-stream ordering not preserved.
